name: ict_g1_ch10_English_seg1

header.subject: English
header.title: Predict + Word Blender + Using a Dictionary (Memory Lane)
header.goal: Children blend sounds, including the letter-teams ea and are, to read new words.

card.bring: textbook p.124 · chalk · word cards · books, pencils

moves.do: Call out m-a-t, c-u-p. The class blends each word.
moves.how: Point to the class for the word.

moves.do: Show p.124. Point to Pinky. Ask what the story is about.
Predict, blend s-u-nn-y, then teach ea and are.
moves.how: Box l-ea-ve, c-are. Name the team, say each sound, blend.
moves.say: “ea says /ee/: l … ee … v, leave! are says /air/: c … air, care!”
moves.think: ‘Songbird’: a bird sings. Pinky looks surprised, so I predict she meets it. Clues: title, picture.

moves.do: Say gr-ou-nd, h-ur-t by sound. Class blends each.
moves.how: Class echoes each sound, then the word.

moves.do: Window side picks a board word, says sounds; partner blends.
moves.how: Sana and Bilal show it first. Window side picks sunny, ground or hurt, says sounds; other blends. 2 pairs share.

turn.a: My sounds: h … ur … t. Blend it!
turn.b: Hurt! (Points to hurt on the board.)
turn.help: Say the sounds slowly; they push them.

moves.do: Everyone writes alone in the book. Blend each word.
moves.how: 1. l-ea-ve · 2. c-are · 3. s-ea-t · 4. d-are · Done? “I think the story is about ___.” or look up ground.

answers: an idea + one clue (title or picture)
sections.mistake: Guesses from first letter. Ask: “Say every sound first.”
sections.stuck: Tap once per sound; child echoes each, then blends.

moves.do: Show r-are and h-ea-t on the board. Five blend aloud.
moves.how: Bilal goes first. Think alone; hear five, sounds first, then the word.
moves.say: “Blend each word sound by sound, out loud.”

sections.correct: Five say rare and heat; can name are as /air/ and ea as /ee/.
sections.success: I can blend the sounds, including ea and are, to read a new word.
sections.ask: How did you work out r-are? Tell me in your own words.
sections.listen: Say r, then are (/air/), then push them together; for h-ea-t, ea says /ee/.

moves.do: Blend the five words for a family member.

expect.html:
GRADE 1 · ENGLISH · Ch.10 Pinky's Garden of Wonders!Day 1 · 40 min

Predict + Word Blender + Using a Dictionary (Memory Lane)

Children blend sounds, including the letter-teams ea and are, to read new words.
Bringtextbook p.124 · chalk · word cards · books, pencils Wordsblend · sunny · ground · hurt · leave · care
PRACTICE · 25 of 40 min
4′ 7′ 13′ 12′ 4′
OpenExplainWe DoYou Do✓
★ Your one thing today · in move

Opening

0–4′Full details ›
1

Call out m-a-t, c-u-p. The class blends each word. Point to the class for the word. “m-a-t …” → class: “mat!”

2

Show p.124. Point to Pinky. Ask what the story is about. Ask: “Seen a songbird?” Take 3 answers. “Today we blend sounds into words.”

Explanation · I Do

4–11′Full details ›
3

Predict, blend s-u-nn-y, then teach ea and are. Box l-ea-ve, c-are. Name the team, say each sound, blend. “ea says /ee/: l … ee … v, leave! are says /air/: c … air, care!”Think aloud: “‘Songbird’: a bird sings. Pinky looks surprised, so I predict she meets it. Clues: title, picture.”

We Do

11–24′Full details ›
4

I START, YOU FINISH
Say gr-ou-nd, h-ur-t by sound. Class blends each. Class echoes each sound, then the word. “gr … ou … nd …” → class: “ground!”

5

ONE NEIGHBOUR TURN
Window side picks a board word, says sounds; partner blends. Sana and Bilal show it first. Window side picks sunny, ground or hurt, says sounds; other blends. 2 pairs share. “Sounds only. Push them together.”Window side first: “My sounds: h … ur … t. Blend it!” → Reply: “Hurt! (Points to hurt on the board.)” · Stop: one clap, eyes on me · Stuck? Say the sounds slowly; they push them.

You Do · in the book

24–36′Full details ›
6

⏱ 24′ stop explaining
Everyone writes alone in the book. Blend each word. 1. l-ea-ve · 2. c-are · 3. s-ea-t · 4. d-are · Done? “I think the story is about ___.” or look up ground. “Sounds first, then push them together.”If stuck: Tap once per sound; child echoes each, then blends.

Check 5 books · answers

1. l-ea-ve →leave
2. c-are →care
3. s-ea-t →seat
4. d-are →dare
Done? Prediction →an idea + one clue (title or picture)

Likely mistake

Guesses from first letter. Ask: “Say every sound first.”

THE BOARD BY THE END · Word Blender

  1. s·u·nn·y sunny
  2. gr·ou·nd ground
  3. h·ur·t hurt
  4. l·ea·ve leave
  5. c·are care

Check · exit ticket

36–40′Full details ›
7

Show r-are and h-ea-t on the board. Five blend aloud. Bilal goes first. Think alone; hear five, sounds first, then the word. “Blend each word sound by sound, out loud.”Ask: “How did you work out r-are? Tell me in your own words.” → Listen for: Say r, then are (/air/), then push them together; for h-ea-t, ea says /ee/.Success: “I can blend the sounds, including ea and are, to read a new word.” 👍 or ✊ firstCorrect: Five say rare and heat; can name are as /air/ and ea as /ee/.

Homework

at homeFull details ›
8

Blend the five words for a family member. Ask them to guess.
